name: Load Agent Skill
description: Load a skill from the [Skills] index by name (or any skill by direct ref). By default its instructions are appended once and stay in context; volatile:true instead watches the source and appends only when its rendered value changes. The loaded skill header names the exact unload key if you later need to remove one; routine cleanup is unnecessary. Loading controls instructions and contributed discovery sources, not authority to call tools already advertised.

name.description: A skill name from the [Skills] index

ref.description: Direct skill address (a/<hash>, v/skills/<x>, w/skills/<x>) — alternative to name

budget.description: Accounting budget for the skill's context entry (default 2000, max 10000)

volatile.description: Watch the skill source before each model call and append new instructions only when its rendered value changes. Default false.
